hypothesis: The original fixed 2000-update budget stopped while validation was still improving; a longer cosine schedule at fixed model and tokenizer improves held-out complete-stream likelihood.

training.selection: minimum prefix-only complete validation CE; FP32 and TF32 disabled; locked test unused

limitations: Small-model, geometry-free ablation; not a reproduction of the 729M-parameter reference
Single-region cohort of 400 training and 55 validation people; test remains frozen
Modeling uses publicly fitted frozen motifs, never controlled-data weights or features

comparison.editable_scope: training duration and its cosine decay schedule only; prefix-only evaluation corrects the diagnostic without changing model or tokenizer
comparison.budget_axis: same model/tokenizer/seed/batch; compare learning curves versus scored target exposure and actual compute; total compute intentionally increases
comparison.smallest_canary: two real training updates, finite gradients, checkpoint reload and prefix-independence probe before exact continuation
comparison.falsifier: validation likelihood plateaus or worsens while training fit improves; do not promote larger capacity without a separate controlled trial
comparison.stopping_rule: 10000 updates or 0.75 worker GPU-hours, whichever first; inspect at each 500-step checkpoint; preserve all endpoints
comparison.reserved_test: not read, encoded or scored during selection
